description: Charging in one U.S. city: "how many chargers does Austin have?", "which networks run the chargers in Chicago?". Send city and state ("Los Angeles" and "CA" or "California"), or slug: the city and state in one line ("Los Angeles, CA") or the city slug (los-angeles-ca). Answers with the city's station count, DC fast and Level 2 counts, top networks and the city page link (url). A city name alone picks the city of that name with the most stations and lists the others under other_matches.

slug.description: Instead of city and state: "Los Angeles, CA" or the city slug (los-angeles-ca)

state.description: The city's state: two-letter code (CO) or name (Colorado)
